python3 << 'EOF'
import json
import math

# Budget expenditures data (in millions) from March 1942 to October 1948
# Format: {year: {month: value}}
# Months: 1=Jan, 2=Feb, 3=Mar, 4=Apr, 5=May, 6=Jun, 7=Jul, 8=Aug, 9=Sep, 10=Oct, 11=Nov, 12=Dec

expenditures = {
    1942: {1: 2680, 2: 2652, 3: 3515, 4: 3939, 5: 4100, 6: 4810, 7: 5257, 8: 5456, 9: 5921, 10: 6184, 11: 6012, 12: 6926},
    1943: {1: 6728, 2: 6358, 3: 7746, 4: 7300, 5: 7475, 6: 8260, 7: 7499, 8: 7831, 9: 7667, 10: 7619, 11: 7947, 12: 7744},
    1944: {1: 7737, 2: 8012, 3: 10412, 4: 7337, 5: 6879, 6: 8631, 7: 8014, 8: 8208, 9: 7779, 10: 8034, 11: 7811, 12: 8327},
    1945: {1: 8142, 2: 7127, 3: 9034, 4: 7758, 5: 8927, 6: 9540, 7: 8561, 8: 6949, 9: 6372, 10: 5619, 11: 4530, 12: 4962},
    1946: {1: 4811, 2: 3340, 3: 3598, 4: 3750, 5: 3374, 6: 4836, 7: 3287, 8: 2745, 9: 2663, 10: 2860, 11: 2453, 12: 3605},
    1947: {1: 3019, 2: 3731, 3: 3239, 4: 3407, 5: 3284, 6: 4996, 7: 3553, 8: 2962, 9: 2673, 10: 2394, 11: 2113, 12: 3176},
    1948: {1: 2800, 2: 2224, 3: 3086, 4: 2541, 5: 2222, 6: 7018, 7: 3558, 8: 2143, 9: 2869, 10: 2685, 11: 2815, 12: 3603},
}

# Extract values from March 1942 (3/1942) to October 1948 (10/1948) inclusive
values = []

# 1942: March to December
for month in range(3, 13):
    values.append(expenditures[1942][month])

# 1943-1947: Full years
for year in range(1943, 1948):
    for month in range(1, 13):
        values.append(expenditures[year][month])

# 1948: January to October
for month in range(1, 11):
    values.append(expenditures[1948][month])

print(f"Number of values: {len(values)}")
print(f"Values: {values}")

# Calculate geometric mean
# GM = (product of all values)^(1/n)
product = 1
for v in values:
    product *= v

geometric_mean = product ** (1/len(values))
print(f"\nGeometric mean: {geometric_mean}")
print(f"Rounded to 2 decimal places: {round(geometric_mean, 2)}")

# Also calculate using log method for verification
log_sum = sum(math.log(v) for v in values)
gm_log = math.exp(log_sum / len(values))
print(f"Geometric mean (log method): {gm_log}")
EOF
